name: get_product_detail
description: Return the full record for one product: description, price, and every variant with its SKU, option label and units available. This is the tool that resolves a product to the SKUs that create_order and modify_order_items require. For live stock on a single known SKU, check_inventory is cheaper and also reports restock timing.

product_id.description: Catalogue product identifier, e.g. P0007. Not a SKU.

error_returns.when: No product exists with the given product_id.
